owner_authority: Owner explicitly starts T153 with 4 hours: 2 derivation, half literature, half selection, plus 1 interleaved empirical work.
scope: Develop useful joint fourth-core/future-response information on V29, with a clear convention for inherited fitted covariance content. Use T155 evidence: metric-only precision is insufficient, and homogeneous conversion needs compatible state regeneration/calibration. Reuse the T148 joint-source and T150 response derivations; prefer the credible larger-gain line over automatically extending the easy HGC clamp change. Keep a distinct conditional or observable-state alternative if it has more upside. Focus any adjacent literature refresh on the chosen missing response/state mechanism. A representation-consistent HGC perturbation is a concrete lead, not a compulsory fallback. Nominate zero to two finite algorithms, with charged cost and explicit subjective success/gain estimates. Interleave numerous small hypothesis probes, partial prototypes and targeted parameter/rank comparisons with derivations. Use their feedback to revise the response/state mechanism. No automatic unchanged old-candidate qualification retry or large sweep/validation campaign.
exploratory_data: Generated examples and public/reused development networks only; repeated target access and adaptive changes labeled exploratory. Historical frozen validation and final blind roles preserved.
probe_record: Short local probe/batch ID with question, code/configuration, inputs and comparator; preserve outputs and what changes in the derivation.
timing: Mutually exclusive active categories; passive waits and routine records excluded. All four category floors will be tracked.
